matched_details: Full name: gazette KABELO GWAMANDA matches 'Kabelo Gwamanda' exactly.
Party: AL JAMA-AH in the gazette; Al Jama-ah councillor in the reporting (IOL 2023-05-05; Citizen 2025-02-25).
Council: City of Johannesburg councillor and former mayor (IOL; Citizen).

court_matters.value: Gwamanda handed himself over to police on 18 October 2024 and appeared in the Protea Magistrate's Court on fraud charges linked to the scheme.
court_matters.label: Alleged
court_matters.outcome: On 25 February 2025 the National Prosecuting Authority provisionally withdrew all charges against him and a co-accused, saying more complainants had come forward and further investigation was needed, after which proceedings would be re-instituted. Gwamanda said the state had no evidence. No re-instituted charges were found in allowed sources as of 15 November 2026.

scandals.value: The Sunday Times reported in June 2023 that, according to the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA), Gwamanda's funeral and burial scheme entity iThemba Lama Afrika was not registered with the FSCA as required, and that it was alleged Soweto residents who contributed to the scheme from 2012 were not paid when they claimed. Gwamanda said the business had failed and that the matter was being used to cast aspersions on him.
scandals.label: Alleged
scandals.outcome: The FSCA confirmed an investigation in June 2023 (Citizen, 2025-02-25). A final FSCA outcome was not found in allowed sources as of 15 November 2026: Unknown.
